relationships.subject: mTORC2

relationships.subject: PTEN
relationships.evidence_quote: PTEN serves as a negative regulator of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway by counteracting PI3K activity

relationships.subject: YAP/TAZ-EZH2-MYC complex
relationships.evidence_quote: YAP/TAZ-EZH2-MYC transcriptional regulators form a nuclear complex that represses PTEN transcription

relationships.subject: PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Overactivation of PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway is central to the etiology of many vascular malformations

key_findings: Review: PI3K/AKT/mTOR hyperactivation is the central hub in slow-flow vascular malformations and PROS, and contributes to AVMs.
Pathway inhibitors are being repurposed in clinical trials for vascular malformations.
